about: Attorney Darren Silver is the founder of Darren Silver & Associates LLP in Los Angeles, California. Mr. Silver devotes his practice to immigration law. Darren Silver Associates, LLP is a full-service Immigration Law Firm that has represented a wide range of immigration clients. Mr. Silver has successfully represented Individuals, Families, Corporations, Entertainers, Athletes, Professionals and Investors in obtaining working Visas and Green Cards.

Mr. Silver has more than 25 years of experience. He has extensive knowledge of business-related immigration visas and issues. He holds a reputation as a leading immigration attorney and serves as a panel attorney for many regional centers in the Los Angeles area. In honor of his accomplishments, EB5 Investors Magazine named him one of the “top 25 EB-5 attorneys” and the Beverly Hills Bar Association included him in their Order of Distinguished Attorneys.

Active in his legal community, Mr. Silver is a member of the immigration section of the Los Angeles County Bar Association, The State Bar of California, the American Bar Association, the American Immigration Lawyers Association and the Invest in the USA, the association for the EB-5 regional centers.
In addition, Mr. Silver is passionate about giving back to those in need. He encourages those in his firm to take on pro bono cases, and he regularly assists indigent immigrants.

Mr. Silver earned a bachelor’s degree in business administration from the University of Southern California and received his law degree from Western State College of Law at Argosy University. He obtained his license to practice law in 1996. He is qualified to appear before all California state courts and the Supreme Court of the United States.
